title: Helwit Banana Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches 15mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Banana Nicotine Pouches (Extra Strong) deliver a smooth, mellow Banana flavour that's soft and sweet without being overly rich. Inspired by classic banana foam sweets, the profile offers a gentle creaminess that sets it apart from sharper fruit blends - ideal for those who prefer a rounded, confectionery-style taste. With 15mg of nicotine per pouch, this high-strength option is tailored for more experienced pouch users. Each slim pouch is made from soft, plant-based fibres and fits comfortably under the lip, releasing nicotine gradually with no smoke, vapour or odour. Crafted in Sweden with climate-conscious production methods, Helwit Banana Extra Strong offers an easy-going pouch with high-impact performance. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
